changesProposed.name: Y Combinator

verified.name: Y Combinator
verified.thesis: Y Combinator invests $500k per company ($125k for 7% equity on post-money SAFE and $375k on uncapped SAFE with MFN clause) in select batches four times per year. The three-month intensive program provides office hours, mentorship, and community access to help startups achieve better products, user bases, and fundraising outcomes before Demo Day.
verified.notes: Garry Tan became President & CEO in January 2023. Jared Friedman succeeded Michael Seibel as Managing Partner in March 2024. Headquarters moved from Mountain View to San Francisco in spring 2023. YC Continuity growth fund was discontinued under Tan's leadership.
